Getting ready for Monday

This week belongs beside your working notes

PLEPIC · Sticky Index Planner

Find a shop in France ↗

12.09.2026 · 3 min

The details that matter ↓

THE USEFUL QUESTION

Do you need a diary for the year or a plan for this week?

Buy from a shop in FranceBefore buying ↓Sources & photos ↓

Name the product precisely

PLEPIC separates Sticky Index Planner from Sticky Index Pad and its bound planners. The product considered here is the Weekly adhesive layout listed by French retailer Moments, with 40 sheets and a stated format of 9.5 × 16.5 cm. The retailer describes repositionable paper notes and manufacture in South Korea. Treat those dimensions as that retailer's listing, rather than specifications for every PLEPIC index product.

Why an undated sheet can be enough

Do you need an annual calendar or a place to organise the next project? An undated weekly sheet lets you start when a project becomes busy, then pause without leaving a run of unused dated spreads. Place the week beside relevant notes. Our preference is to give each sheet one job: a project, a short study plan or a personal week, with its dates written clearly at the top.

Where a dated notebook wins

A bound dated diary gives each appointment a fixed address and makes earlier weeks straightforward to find. Adhesive sheets demand more decisions: where the current plan lives, which notebook holds completed work, and what happens when you remove a sheet. If you regularly book far ahead, or need to reconstruct a sequence of commitments, use the diary as your main calendar. The PLEPIC sheet can then hold this week's actions without becoming a second competing appointment list.

Choose the layout before the colour

Weekly is useful for distributing tasks over several days. A Monthly grid makes more sense for milestones, while a To Do layout suits tasks with no meaningful date. These are separate variants; a collective photograph does not establish pack contents. Compare the actual writing area with your handwriting. Measure your notebook page, including margins and binding, rather than assuming that a compact-looking pad will fit. A protruding index also needs room inside the cover.

Make the paper system easy to keep

Before committing important notes, try one sheet on an ordinary spare page and check your chosen pen. We have not verified adhesion over time, repeated repositioning, fountain-pen behaviour or removal from delicate papers. Keep completed plans in a consistent section if they matter later. For France, the Moments listing offers a useful local reference for the exact Weekly variant; match its name and pack details when comparing another seller. The purchase is worthwhile when it simplifies a notebook you already use.

A MOMENT BEFORE CHECKOUT

Worth a closer look

  • Confirm Weekly, Monthly or To Do on the selected pack.
  • Compare the listed 40-sheet format with your notebook's usable page area.
  • Choose one home for current plans and one for completed sheets.
  • Verify the destination served and the selected variant before ordering.

Skip it if your priority is a complete chronological archive or an appointment calendar you can fill months ahead. A dated notebook is easier to maintain for those jobs.
